<action type="say">
Here are exact click-by-click steps for Outlook on Windows (desktop), assuming the meeting is on your calendar:

1) Open Outlook Calendar
   - In Outlook, click the “Calendar” icon at the bottom-left.

2) Go to the date of the existing meeting
   - In the left date picker, click on **December 11, 2025**.
   - At the top, choose a view where you can clearly see times, e.g. **Day** or **Week**.

3) Locate the meeting
   - In the time grid for that day, find **“Panel Discussion”** at **3:00–4:30 PM**.

4) Open the meeting
   - **Double-click** the “Panel Discussion” meeting to open the meeting window (not just the preview).

5) Change the date
   - In the meeting window, look near the top for:
     - **Start time:** [date + time field]
     - **End time:** [date + time field]
   - In the **Start time** date field, click the drop-down calendar and change **12/11/2025** to **12/15/2025**.
   - The **End time** date will usually update automatically to **12/15/2025**; if it doesn’t, change it manually to **12/15/2025**.

6) Keep the same time
   - Ensure the times still read:
     - **Start time:** 3:00 PM
     - **End time:** 4:30 PM  
   - Also confirm the **Time zone** (if shown) is **(UTC-05:00) Eastern Time (US & Canada)** or whatever your usual Eastern setting is.

7) Save and send the update
   - In the meeting window, click **Send Update** (or **Send** in newer versions) in the upper-left.
   - If prompted, choose **Send updates to all attendees**.

That will move the “Panel Discussion” from **Thursday, 12/11/2025, 3:00–4:30 PM** to **Monday, 12/15/2025, 3:00–4:30 PM**.

If your Outlook is slightly different (e.g., Outlook on the web in a browser), tell me and I’ll give the web version’s exact clicks.</action>
